slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.7.2
slides.subtitle: October 2026
slides.summary: Clock in for a paycheck, haul on your own terms, buy a business of your own and put your car on the new dyno. Here's everything that's new.

slides.title: Get hired at BPS or Fink Industries
slides.summary: Clock in at a company yard, drive their trucks, and get paid when the shift is done.
facts: Employment app preinstalled; Hiring Now only lists jobs your Logistics level unlocks
Company trucks, trailers and fuel for parcels, materials, car jockey and car hauling
Shifts, freight and held pay survive service visits, reloads and accidents
Report an accident or an undeliverable load from the radial menu
Headhunters call at skill milestones; speed traps fine company vehicles too

slides.title: Job Broker and owner-operator hauling
slides.summary: Find commercial work on the phone, reserve it remotely, and haul it with your own rig or a rented one.
facts: Six markets, from parcels and trailer loads to bulk, car hauling and specialty cargo
Reserve and load as many parcels as your rig holds, and choose which box each goes in
Rent trucks and trailers by the hour at Commercial Vehicle Sales
Car haulers check the car is really on the deck before it counts as loaded
Multi-car hauling contracts come to Pepper Valley and Utah with their updated map packs

slides.title: Own a business, or several
slides.summary: Buy West Coast Engine Works, the Dino Cafe or one of seventeen storefronts, then keep them stocked.
facts: Engine Works: $200,000 with $50,000 down; certify blueprints, build and sell engines
The Dino Cafe is for sale with its own garage, and owners use its dyno for free
Mini marts, cafes, nail salons, jewelers and gift shops, each with its own supplies
New Business Computer with Dashboard, Stock & Supplies, Finances and Upgrades
Buy engines at Belasco Engine Exchange and Javi Motor Parts, priced from their real parts

slides.title: A rebuilt dyno and a tuner in your pocket
slides.summary: Strap in at the hub dyno, then fine-tune boost from your phone.
facts: New dyno screen with guidance, live readouts, results and saved-pull comparisons
Smoother curves; 2WD and 4WD now read the same; warnings no longer void a paid run
OBD Scanner returns with engine, service and drivetrain data, plus low oil alerts
Kapoow Racing PRO Tuner: a $5,000 license for live wastegate tuning and dyno sheets
Steering wheels no longer jolt during pulls; force feedback returns when you leave

slides.title: Tractor pulls, cleanups and car clubs
slides.summary: New ways to spend a day, and car meets that remember who you are.
facts: Tractor Pull: sleds from 8,000 to 30,000 lb, 300 ft full pull, up to $4,000
Cleanup Club: 17 more sites to clear for parts, cash or a project car
Car meet reputation is now one player-wide score, capped at 100
New Bruckell Ravix and Cherrier Ardente owners' clubs
Freeroam events work outside career; police duty tracks arrests and BOLOs

slides.title: Take the whole rig across the water
slides.summary: A new West Coast ferry carries you between maps, trailers and cargo included.
facts: Map travel brings coupled trailers and cars loaded on your carrier
Every map trip now arrives at 8 AM instead of the middle of the night
Tow to road moves the car on your hauler along with the truck
Quick travel and recovery leave you standing beside your car, facing it

slides.title: Career screens and saves
slides.lead: Every computer screen rebuilt, and saves that stay out of your way.

columns.heading: Career screens
items: Computer, business and shop screens share one clean style
Full controller support; B steps back one layer at a time
Money and distances follow your unit settings
Hold to check in Maintenance; Engine Package parts list
Install parts from your own inventory in the part shop

columns.heading: Saves
items: Pick an autosave interval from 5 to 60 minutes
Autosaves wait until you stop, with a short warning
No autosaves during races, missions or shopping
A Saving career notice shows while it writes
Purchases are saved right away

columns.heading: Phone
items: Map key opens the map during delivery mode
Day/night toggle stays in sync with the computer
Phone tutorial starts reliably on a new career
Marketplace buttons no longer cut off
Skill levels show correctly on Career Paths

slides.title: And everything else
slides.lead: The smaller changes that add up.

columns.heading: Pay and balance
items: Logistics pay rebalanced; +5% cargo pay per level from 31
Logistics bonuses use your real level, so pay keeps rising
Taxi fares and recovery jobs now pay by distance
Multipliers no longer stack twice on materials, taxi and repo
Police are 5% of traffic, with more vehicle variety
Engine and spare-part prices follow real part values

columns.heading: Garage and driving
items: Burnouts and slides wear tires much faster
Used cars come with at least 40% tire life
Hybrids, EVs and mod engines get the right maintenance
Refuel a nearby car from the pump while on foot
Towing a wrecked rig home no longer repairs it
Rare cars are rarer; zero-population mods can appear

columns.heading: Fixes
items: No more invisible wheels or cars after parts shopping
License plates no longer show a missing texture
Auction cars keep their model year and value
Bus shifts can end mid-route and recover from interruptions
Bought cars keep their paint at car meets
Concrete mixer loads stay stable
